# Test fixtures

Files in this directory must be safe to store in a public repository.

- No live malware, ever. Samples needed for authorized research belong in a separate,
  access-controlled location and are not referenced by the default test suites.
- Prefer fixtures generated by the tests themselves (see `tests/support/`). Generated inputs
  document exactly which bytes are being tested and need no licensing review.
- Any checked-in binary must be benign, small, and listed below with its origin and license.
